source.mutability: The official URL is mutable; generation and publish revalidation fail closed unless its bytes still match this hash. Outreach states that custom objects are not included.

request_integer_policy.representation: JSON:API resource and relationship IDs inside body.data are exact decimal strings
request_integer_policy.transport: Structured object forwarding preserves those strings without JavaScript number coercion

repaired_compatibility_arguments.query_transport: Every caller-controlled query key now uses the query. prefix consumed by connection.api; eight bundled recipes were upgraded with the same wire keys.
repaired_compatibility_arguments.json_api_body_transport: The five compatibility creates now expose one structured body.data object; deeper dotted body keys would serialize as literal property names.

auth.selected: Bearer token supplied only by the enrolled Outreach connection
